parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all()
  .map(item => item.json)
  .filter(row =>
    !row.error &&
    String(row.target_sheet || row.table_name || '').trim() === 'ChannelMonthly' &&
    String(row.maturity_status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'matured' &&
    !/^(1|true|yes)$/i.test(String(row.is_provisional || 'false')) &&
    String(row.game_code || '').trim() &&
    String(row.period_key || row.month || '').trim() &&
    String(row.data_hash || '').trim()
  )
  .map(row => ({ json: {
    request_id: `AIHOOK-${row.game_code}-${row.period_key || row.month}-${Date.now()}`,
    trigger_type: 'master_matured_dataindex_written',
    central_db_id: row.central_db_id || $('Set Runtime Config').first().json.central_db_id,
    target_game_code: row.game_code,
    target_month: row.period_key || row.month,
    prompt_version: 'ai-summary-v3-direct-master',
    force_refresh: false,
    expected_data_hash: row.data_hash,
    maturity_status: 'matured'
  }}));
